notes.title: Queen’s Garden: French Splendor Launch Party!
notes.content:
Get ready for a blooming good time with [b]Queen’s Garden: French Splendor! [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3049410/Queens_Garden__French_Splendor

[list]
[*] Dive into 110 levels of match-3 gardening chaos as Marigold and Florian bumble their way through transforming a royal garden disaster into a masterpiece worthy of Versailles. 
[*] With quirky characters, laugh-out-loud moments, and endless decorating possibilities, this isn’t just a game—it’s a horticultural revolution.
[*] Come for the puzzles, stay for the laughs, and leave with a garden that even snails will envy!
[/list]
